collection.title: Mitsubishi Shogun Sport 2015 to 2021 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Shogun 2015 - 2021 requires a 21" wiper blade the drivers side and a 18" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the Retrofit style wiper.
